saurabh_extraction: In the page, Appendix A prints each matrix in a <pre class='ltx_verbatim'> block, one row per line, characters 0 and 1. The first three such blocks, in page order, are the 13x19, 14x19 and 16x18 matrices. The script takes the lines of each block, joins them with LF and adds a final LF.
